item.title: KANADE gets surprise Switch port
item.description: Publisher Good Smile Company and developer Frontwing have announced a surprise Switch port for KANADE, their music-themed visual novel. KANADE is now available for Switch (via the eShop) in Japan. The game supports Japanese, English, and Chinese languages. The musical visual novel has been available worldwide for Windows PC (via Steam) since June 2025. Source
